sn_aia_tool.description:
Retrieves and analyzes Food Base Problem records from the Campus Food Services Assistant application for management reporting.
Analyze available Food Base Problem data including Use Case, Problem Type, Student Count, Meal Type, Mess Hall, State, Priority, Priority Reason, Problem Type Normalized, Knowledge Insights, Recommended Action, and Related Knowledge Articles.
Return only information retrieved from the application. Calculate totals, distributions, affected-student counts, and breakdowns from the available records. Do not invent missing data or unsupported conclusions.
sn_aia_tool.name: Food Base Problem Analytics
